description: This file declares functions for mathematical operations involving Rational numbers within the RationalMath namespace, including basic arithmetic, power, root, trigonometric, hyperbolic, and logarithmic functions.

methods.name: Frac
methods.description: Returns the fractional part of a Rational number.

methods.name: Integer
methods.description: Returns the integer part of a Rational number.

methods.name: Pow
methods.description: Calculates the power of a Rational base raised to a Rational exponent.

methods.name: Root
methods.description: Calculates the root of a Rational base with a Rational degree.

methods.name: Fact
methods.description: Returns the factorial of a Rational number.

methods.name: Mod
methods.description: Calculates the modulus of two Rational numbers.

methods.name: Exp
methods.description: Calculates the exponential of a Rational number.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of a Rational number.

methods.name: Log10
methods.description: Calculates the base-10 logarithm of a Rational number.

methods.name: Invert
methods.description: Returns the multiplicative inverse of a Rational number.

methods.name: Abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of a Rational number.

methods.name: Sin
methods.description: Calculates the sine of a Rational angle, given an AngleType.

methods.name: Cos
methods.description: Calculates the cosine of a Rational angle, given an AngleType.

methods.name: Tan
methods.description: Calculates the tangent of a Rational angle, given an AngleType.

methods.name: ASin
methods.description: Calculates the arcsine of a Rational number, given an AngleType.

methods.name: ACos
methods.description: Calculates the arccosine of a Rational number, given an AngleType.

methods.name: ATan
methods.description: Calculates the arctangent of a Rational number, given an AngleType.

methods.name: Sinh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic sine of a Rational number.

methods.name: Cosh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic cosine of a Rational number.

methods.name: Tanh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic tangent of a Rational number.

methods.name: ASinh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic sine of a Rational number.

methods.name: ACosh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a Rational number.

methods.name: ATanh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a Rational number.
